Results.ReviewText:
After looking a lot of other less expensive grills, I decided to go with this one because of the longer warranty.  This grill heats well enough, but it is very difficult to control the heat level.  With all burners on, it gets plenty hot enough, but when you try to regulate the temperature by lowering all of the burners, the temperature barely moves.  This may be typical of most gas grills, but I expected better of Weber.
It does do a good job of indirect heating with one or two burners off.  If the food isn’t placed directly over the flame it is much easier to control without flareups.  
Like some other reviewers have stated, I’m also not crazy about it having only two wheels.  That does make it more difficult to move it.  The grill otherwise seems reasonably well constructed.  Time will tell how long it lasts.
Results.Title: Does the job, with limitations.

Results.ReviewText:
This grill was solidly designed. It went together easily and was tight and sturdy when assembled. 
It is the perfect size for 4 people. I have owned larger grills in the past but they take longer to preheat; can get this to 500degF in about 5 mins. It lights immediately.
 4 NY strips take up less than half the grill. I cooked a 3 lb chuck roast this week and had plenty of room to cook indirectly.
I like that I can get temp fairly low when needed.
I haven’t needed to clean down inside it yet but I absolutely appreciate the replaceable drip pan and the easy to clean grates. 
I still need to figure out the installation on the warming rack.
The Spirit E310 was well worth the money. Happy knowing I didn’t need to spend extra $$ for the upgraded models. I should have bought this years ago .
Results.Title: Solid, good performance & worth the $$

Results.ReviewText:
The frame/body of the BBQ is probably made from some cheap & thin composite material.
As a result hinges were broken in the box on 2 different BBQs.
Packaging looked normal so I took first one home and as soon as I opened it up I noticed that the right hinge was broken, returned it to HomeDepot the other day and got second one in stock.
Again, complete & properly packaged box and I thought it should be just a bad luck with the first one and took that one home w/o checking in store.
Guess what, this time it is the other hinge (left one), plus some dents on the black shiny cover.
I don't know if both were part of the same shipment and somehow defective or what but to be honest I was expecting more from such well reviewed product.
I hope Weber will review cases with HomeDepot Canada to figure out what is going on.
And as for me, I think I'll just try something else since it is really painful to visit the store every other day to pickup new BBQ.
Results.Title: Poor quality
